correctness.rationale: The published support-point characterization reduces the problem to cap barycenters. For normals in one octant, the cap is exhaustively either a full-height trapezoid or a corner triangle; exact integration gives the stated barycenters and transition at m=delta/2. Eliminating the normal parameter yields the two conics. Green integration gives the exact area, and the above-half-area formula follows from the zero centroid and complementary caps. The standalone replay independently checks cap areas, barycenters, conic identities, reconstructed area, and complement scaling.

value.rationale: The square is the canonical nonsmooth centrally symmetric planar body, while Ulam floating bodies are a recent convex-geometric transform tied to cap barycenters, metronoids, affine surface area, and average quantiles. The result gives a complete all-level model with explicit support geometry, a nontrivial parabola-to-hyperbola transition, exact area, and the polytope-type delta log(1/delta) deficit. It is a reusable benchmark rather than a routine substitution.
